from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "FillDeepWellPlateWithLBAndInoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 1)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", 3)
    tiprack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 4)
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 5)

    # Define liquids
    protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids
    # Load 48000 µL of LB into reservoir well A1
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="lb", volume=48000)
    # Load 100 µL of glycerol_stock into each well of glycerol_plate
    for well in glycerol_plate.well_names():
        glycerol_plate[well].load_liquid(liquid="glycerol_stock", volume=100)

    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])

    # Fill deep well plate with 500 µL LB per well
    p1000.pick_up_tip()
    for well in deep_plate.well_names():
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[well])
    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 µL from matching glycerol well
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for well in deep_plate.well_names():
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well])
        p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[well])
    p20.drop_tip()

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "FillDeepWellPlateWithLBAndInoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 1)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", 3)
    tiprack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 4)
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 5)

    # Define liquids
    protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="lb", volume=48000)
    for well in glycerol_plate.well_names():
        glycerol_plate[well].load_liquid(liquid="glycerol_stock", volume=100)

    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])

    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    p1000.pick_up_tip()
    for well in deep_plate.well_names():
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[well])
    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul from matching glycerol well
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for well in deep_plate.well_names():
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well])
        p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[well])
    p20.drop_tip()"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):

    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)

    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)

    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul from matching glycerol well
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for well in deep_plate.well_names():
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well])

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "FillDeepWellPlateWithLBAndInoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 1)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", 3)
    tiprack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 4)
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 5)

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for name in glycerol_plate.well_names:
        glycerol_plate[name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol, volume=100)

    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])

    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    p1000.pick_up_tip()
    for name in deep_plate.well_names:
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[name])
    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul from matching glycerol well
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for name in deep_plate.well_names:
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[name])
        p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[name])
    p20.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "FillDeepWellPlateWithLBAndInoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def generate_well_names(plate):
    """Return a list of well names for a 96-well plate (A1-H12)."""
    letters = "ABCDEFGH"
    names = []
    for row in range(1, 13):
        for col in range(8):
            names.append(letters[col] + str(row))
    return names

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 1)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", 3)
    tiprack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 4)
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 5)

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for name in generate_well_names(glycerol_plate):
        glycerol_plate[name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol, volume=100)

    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])

    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    p1000.pick_up_tip()
    for name in generate_well_names(deep_plate):
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[name])
    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul from matching glycerol well
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for name in generate_well_names(deep_plate):
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[name])
        p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[name])
    p20.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "FillDeepWellPlateWithLBAndInoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def generate_well_names(plate):
    """Return a list of well names for a 96-well plate (A1-H12)."""
    letters = "ABCDEFGH"
    names = []
    for row in range(1, 13):
        for col in range(8):
            names.append(letters[col] + str(row))
    return names

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 1)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", 3)
    tiprack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 4)
    tiprack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 5)

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for name in glycerol_plate.well_names():
        glycerol_plate[name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol, volume=100)

    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tiprack_20])

    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    p1000.pick_up_tip()
    for name in generate_well_names(deep_plate):
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[name])
    p1000.drop_tip()

    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul from matching glycerol well
    for name in generate_well_names(deep_plate):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[name])
        p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[name])
        # Mix the well to ensure homogenous distribution
        p20.mix(5, 10, deep_plate[name])
        p20.drop_tip()"}

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: A pipette too small to mix 94 wells: 20 ul at most in 505 ul
   line 48:  p20.mix(5, 10, deep_plate[name])
   At line 48 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 86 more in slot 3 with
   5 strokes of 10 ul in a well holding 505 ul (this line did it 94 times). The P20 can draw
   at most 20 ul, under a fifth of the well: no stroke it can make will mix this well,
   however many times. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8%
   CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you
   calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 86 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix with a bigger pipette (a P300 for this well): at least 5 strokes of 300 ul,
   `mix(5, 300, well)`.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [8500dd6331b3]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
